_meta.scenario: video attachment, explicit timestamp (time_range) on standard_chat — keyframes lost
_meta.semantics: 'around 1:45:00' -> routeQuery single HMS -> time_range [c-180, c+180] -> only the overlapping chunk survives, with a [01:45:00 - 01:46:00] header (fmtStamp). rules() uses the video variant. PRODUCTION BUG RECORDED (not fixed, §8): nearestFrames DID load the keyframe, but buildAttachmentTurn appends frames to messages[userIdx] (turn.ts:224) where userIdx = lastUserIdx+1 — undefined on standard_chat (no skill block, no shift) — so the frame is SILENTLY DROPPED: the forwarded user turn has NO image_url part. retrieval_done still reports {1,1} (blocks, not frames).

env.embed_seam: embedOne fixed pseudo-vector [1,0,0.05]; index seeded via production writeIndex (BM25/RRF/pack unmocked)

_meta.normalization: Stage-event "ms" timing values replaced with "<ms>" in logicalFrames; progress-path bodies are ms-normalized text.
